lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters. Between the fifth gill slit and the anterior base of the dorsal fin, there are approximately 6 discernible columns, each containing 3 to 5 distinct nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal alignment of the circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs strictly bounded within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin; approximately 6-8 spots are visible, primarily concentrated toward the anterior margin.
